verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible headline > subline > CTA order. But the elements step down the canvas diagonally with no shared baseline, the 'Try It' button is jammed near the right edge, and the bottom third is dead orange space, so it reads like the banner dropped onto a taller canvas. B rearranges more boldly, but the CTA pill butts into the bottom of the product circle, 'Out now.' is stranded beside the button instead of under the headline, and the button crowds the bottom edge while the lower left sits empty.
